(23 April 2016) | attendance = 902,643 | average attendance = 6,838 | prevseason = [[2015 Liga Super|2015]] | nextseason = [[2017 Liga Super|2017]] | updated = 22 October 2016 | season = 2016 }} The '''2016 Malaysia Super League''' ({{langx|en|'''2016 Super League'''}}) was the 13th season of the [[Malaysia Super League]], the top-tier professional [[association football|football]] league in Malaysia.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesm/malay2016.html] 2016 Liga Super The season began on 13 February and concluded on 22 October 2016.{{cite web |url=http://footballmalaysia.com/portal/index.php/2015/11/26/liga-super-dan-liga-premier-2016-bermula-februari/ |title=Liga Super dan Liga Premier 2016 Bermula Februari |date=26 November 2015 |work=Football Association of Malaysia |publisher=Football Malaysia |language=ms |access-date=26 November 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160219214327/http://footballmalaysia.com/portal/index.php/2015/11/26/liga-super-dan-liga-premier-2016-bermula-februari/ |archive-date=19 February 2016 |url-status=dead }} [[Johor Darul Ta'zim F.C.|Johor Darul Ta'zim]] were the defending champions and retained the title from the previous season. They became the first club in the Malaysian football history to win the Liga Super title for three consecutive years. Johor Darul Ta'zim also set a new record after went through the season without a single defeat – the first team ever to do so in a 22-fixtures league season. Johor Darul Ta'zim finished its "Invincibles" season with 18 wins, 4 draws, 0 defeats and 58 points in total. ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} ===To Malaysia Super League=== '''Promoted from [[2015 Malaysia Premier League|Premier League]]''' * [[Kedah FA|Kedah]] * [[Penang FA|Penang]] * [[T-Team F.C.|T-Team]] {{col-break|gap=3em}} ===From Malaysia Super League=== '''Relegated to [[2016 Malaysia Premier League|Premier League]]''' * [[ATM FA|ATM]] * [[Sime Darby F.C.|Sime Darby]] '''End of (MoU)''' * [[LionsXII]]{{cite web|url=https://www.bharian.com.my/taxonomy/term/3/2015/11/99809/lions-xii-tidak-lagi-beraksi-dalam-liga-malaysia-fam|title=Lions XII tidak lagi beraksi dalam Liga Malaysia - FAM|website=BH Online|publisher=Berita Harian}} {{col-end}} ==Teams== [[Sime Darby F.C.|Sime Darby]] were relegated after finishing bottom in the [[2015 Liga Super|2015 season]].
